svg.title: Agentroid
svg.desc: Agentroid, an Android agent bridge for MCP clients. Diagram: any MCP client, the brain, calls a TypeScript MCP server, then a Rust core that puts a risk label on every action, then a deny-by-default adb gate with a device allowlist, then Android emulators. Animated requests: R0 read and R1 navigate pass through; R4 destructive is held at the gate for approval. No model API key: the calling agent is the brain. Open-source release planned.
